description: Counts the business's contacts (the People place's relationships): the total, by kind (person, org, outlet, creator, customer, subscriber, prospect) and by stage (unknown, aware, contacted, replied, engaged, converted, churned, declined), how many may not be contacted now (suppressed), and the touches of the last days: total, out and in, by channel and by kind (pitch, email, reply, dm, order, sign-up and the rest). Use it for the shape of the relationships; to find someone use crm_search, for one person's history crm_timeline.

days.description: The span for the touches, in days back from now; the contact counts are always all of them.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
